summary: The patch addresses the issue of rational numbers not being wrapped in mpmath correctly, but there are some concerns about test coverage and potential impacts on other parts of the code.

issues.description: There are no additional tests added to verify the new functionality specifically for the mpmath module. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be included to ensure the fix works as intended.
The change might introduce behavioral changes for other expressions involving Rational numbers when using the mpmath printer. It is important to verify that this does not break existing behavior.
